la:verb:obmutesco.gloss: to lose one's speech, become dumb
senses: to lose one's speech, become dumb
la:verb:obmutesco.html:
ob-mūtesco, tŭi, 3,
v. inch. n., to become dumb, to lose one's speech (syn.: taceo, sileo).
Lit.: qui ebrius obmutuit,: cum obmutuerint,: umbrae ejus (hyaenae) contactu canes obmutescere,lose their voice, their bark,; .—
Transf., in gen., to be speechless, mute, silent: ipse obmutescam,: de me ... nulla umquam obmutescat vetustas,: Aeneas aspectu obmutuit amens,: dixit pressoque obmutuit ore,: obmutuit illa dolore,.—
Trop., to become silent, to cease: studium nostrum conticuit subito et obmutuit,: animi dolor,: Lydium sil nunc obmutuit,is no longer asked for,: dixit mari, obmutesce,.
